migration_position: Memory may move to a new runtime architecture, but evidence sovereignty and reversible migration must be preserved.

evidence.role: Original material. Never rewritten by migration.

decision_memory.role: Why a judgment was accepted, deferred, or rejected.

runtime_memory.role: Upstream Mercury Agent runtime recall, including Second Brain if enabled.

external_brain_targets.role: gbrain, Mercury Agent, OpenClaw, or markdown import queues. Export-only until a schema-aware adapter owns ingestion.

migration_gates: map each candidate to a memory type and source_refs
shadow-test recall without deleting artifact originals
write an audit report before cutover
keep rollback instructions with the migration bundle
forbidden_migrations: import unapproved candidates into runtime memory
write to upstream SQLite directly without a schema-aware adapter
mix third-party licensed text into public memory exports without source policy review
